overview: Enterprise adoption of ChatGPT is expanding in finance, highlighted by Sumitomo Life’s internal rollout.
OpenAI details its risk‑management framework for frontier models from training to deployment.
Anthropic’s record‑size IPO underscores investor confidence despite broader market volatility.

top.title: How Sumitomo Life’s leaders helped teams adopt ChatGPT Enterprise
top.summary: Sumitomo Life deployed ChatGPT Enterprise for insurer research, proposal drafting, and investment‑analysis code, with executives leading early use to encourage company‑wide adoption.

top.title: Managing frontier AI risk: From training to deployment
top.summary: OpenAI outlines its frontier‑AI risk controls, including model alignment, sandbox environments, safety blocks, and continuous monitoring throughout training and deployment.

top.title: Anthropic prices IPO at $83 a share, above projected range
top.summary: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share, raising $81.3 billion—the largest ever by proceeds—valuing the company near $1.5 trillion and testing market appetite for AI stocks.

top.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Neon
top.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Neon, a high‑capability model optimized for complex software, knowledge, and scientific tasks, priced at $3 per million input tokens and supporting a 1 million‑token context.

top.title: The Gemini app is now available on lower-memory Android devices.
top.summary: Google launched a re‑engineered Gemini app for low‑memory Android devices, enabling voice interaction, real‑time translation, and image generation for hundreds of millions of users.

top.title: Time-Series Models in the Streamhouse: A New Frontier and Use Cases
top.summary: IBM and Confluent introduced CPU‑only time‑series foundation models, integrated into Apache Flink for real‑time forecasting and anomaly detection across streaming data pipelines.
